few_shot_examples.cq: What are all available publications and their titles?
What publications were submitted by authors who have a recorded role?
few_shot_examples.query:
PREFIX coresr-ont: <http://example.org/core_scholar_rich/>
SELECT ?title
WHERE {
  ?publication coresr-ont:hasTitle ?title .
  ?publication coresr-ont:submittedBy ?author .
  ?agent coresr-ont:performsRole ?author .
}

few_shot_examples.cq: What publications were published after a certain date?
few_shot_examples.query:
PREFIX coresr-ont: <http://example.org/core_scholar_rich/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?publication
WHERE {
  ?publication coresr-ont:dateOfPublication ?date .
  FILTER (?date > "2020-01-01"^^xsd:date)
}

few_shot_examples.cq: What fields of study are represented by publications from universities in each state?
few_shot_examples.query:
PREFIX coresr-ont: <http://example.org/core_scholar_rich/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?state ?fieldOfStudy
WHERE {
  ?publication coresr-ont:associatedFieldOfStudy ?fieldOfStudy .
  ?publication coresr-ont:submittedBy ?author .
  ?agent coresr-ont:performsRole ?author .
  ?agent coresr-ont:associatedWith ?department .
  ?department coresr-ont:partOf ?college .
  ?college coresr-ont:partOf ?university .
  ?university coresr-ont:locatedAt ?location .
  ?location coresr-ont:atState ?state .
}
